The Cécred Gallery

Pop Up Mob marked Cécred's ULTA FLC trade show debut by transforming the booth into an immersive brand world designed for discovery, education, and a major moment with Miss Tina herself to introduce the brand to ULTA beauty managers and community members.

BeautyApril 2025San Antonio, Texas100% Experiential
The Story
San Antonio, TX

The space came to life through large-scale brand visuals and striking overhead drapery that drew attention from across the convention floor, alongside live styling panels and workshops celebrating diverse hair types. Guests learned about the products through an ingredient education table and trichoscope scalp analysis, tested products firsthand, and experienced special moments with Miss Tina herself, transforming the booth into a destination for discovery, education, and connection with the Cécred universe.
